paite: Hiai thilte zoh in, kumpipa Ahasueras thangpaihna lungkimsak a om in, Vasti bang ahia ahih, asiatna dia bang ahia thupiak chih atheigige hi.
heading: Esther Kumpinu Hong Hi

paite: Huchi in anasepsak kumpipa sikhate'n akiang ah, "Kumpipa a ding in nungak siangthou tuailai melhoih kizong henla,

kumpipa'n agam a bial tengteng ah heutu sep hen, huaite'n nungak siangthou tuailai tengteng Susa Inpi ah, numeite inn ah, Hegai kumpipa michilgeh numeite kempa in ahon pikhawm theihna ding un; huchi in siansakna ding a thilte uh amau kipeleh.
Huchi in nungak kumpipa lungkimsak pen Vasti sik in kumpinu hi hen," achi uhi. Huai thil in kumpipa alungkimsak a; huchibang in ahihta hi.
Susa Inpi ah Juda mi kuahiam, amin Mordekai, Jair tapa, Shimei tapa, Benjamin mi a-om a;
amah bel Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judah kumpipa Jekoniah apimang a om salte toh pimang in a-om uhi.
Ama'n Hadassah, huai tuh Esther, apaneu tanu akem piching hi; ama'n nu leh pa anei kei. Huai nungak akilawm in amel ahoih hi, anu leh pa asih un Mordekai in atanu ding in ala hi.
Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa thupiak leh athubawl akizak in, nungak tampi Susa Inpi, Hegai in akaihkhawm a-om lai un, Esther leng kumpipa' inn ah, Hegai, numeite kempa nuai ah ahon pi uhi.

Huchi in nungak in amah alungkimsak a, ama deihsakna angahta a; ama'n siansakna ding in athilte amah ape pah a, atantuante toh, amah piak ding akilawm, kumpipa' inn a kipan nungak sagih toh; amah leh anungakte numeite inn a mun hoihpen ah asuanta hi.
Esther in ahihna agenkhe kei a, atanaute hihna leng agenkhe sam kei hi; Mordekai in lah genkhe lou ding in amah athuhilh ngal a.
Huchi in Mordekai bel niteng in numeite inn mai ah Esther in bangchi in ahih zel a, bang ahong chi dia chih thei ding in ahoh zel hi.

Numeite a dia dan dungzui a kha sawm-le-nih, murrah thau toh kha guk, gimnamtuite toh kha guk leh numeite siansakna ding a thilte toh, huchibang in asiansakna nite hihkim a a-om nung in, nungak chih kumpipa Ahasueras kiang a ava lut hun uh atungta hi.
Nungakte kumpipa kiang a alut chiang un, kumpipa' inn a hohpih ding in numeite omna a kipan adeihdeih uh piak in a-om uhi.

Nitaklam in apai a, azing nawn in numeite inn nihna ah, kumpipa michilgeh Shasgaz, meite kempa inn ah ahong kik a, kumpipa amah ah kipak napi in, kumpipa kiang ah ahong lut kei a, amin a sap in a-om hi.

Huchi a amah atanu ding a lapa, Mordekai paneu Abihail tanu, Esther kumpipa kiang a ava lut hun ahong tun in, Hegai kumpipa michilgeh, numeite kempa a seh chih ngal louh bangmah akan kei hi. Huchi in amah ente tengteng mitmuh in Esther in deihsakna atang hi.
Huchi in Esther kumpipa Ahasueras kiang a kumpi inn ah akha sawmna, Tebeth kha a avaihawm kum sagihna kum in laklut in a-omta hi.

Huchi in kumpipa'n numei tengteng sang in Esther a-it a, nungak siangthoute sang in amitmuh in hehpihna leh deihsakna atang hi. Huchi in alutung ah lallukhu akoih a, Vasti sik in kumpinu ding in amah abawlta hi.

Huchih lai in kumpipa'n avaihawmte tengteng leh asikhate tengteng a ding in ankuang thupi, "Esther Ankuang mahmah," aluita a; bialte kiang ah khawlna abawl a, kumpipa siamna bang zel in, thilpiakte apia hi.
Huchi a nungak siangthoute nihveina dia kaihkhawm a-om lai un, Mordekai bel kumpipa kongpi ah atu hi.
heading: Mordekai In Kumpipa Hinna Ahondam

paite: Esther in atanaute leh amite hihna agenkhe kei; amah kiang a khanletsak a om bangtak in Mordekai thupiak bang in ahih hi.
Huai lai a, Mordekai kumpipa kongpi a atut lai in, kumpipa michilgeh lak a nih, Bigthan leh Teresh, kongkhak ngakte aheh ua, kumpipa Ahasueras tung a khut kha ding in azongta uhi.
Huai thil Mordekai in athei a, ama'n kumpinu kiang ah atheisak hi. Esther in Mordekai min in huai akumpipa ahilhta hi.
Huchi in athu akikanleh, huchibang ahi ngei chih akimukhia a, anih un sing dawn ah khailup in a-om uhi. Hiai thu tanchin gelhna laibu ah kumpipa ma ah akigelh hi.
